title: The Hollow Ember Again
author: Kestrel Kavanagh
blurb: Ada Galloway, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
